scope: M32 read-only reanalysis of hash-verified M31 measurements. 35_17 only; original root positions restored for source travel. User hip vertical is a comparison reference, not a normative landing target. No correction or counterfactual animation.

coordinateContract.x: common fixed heading, horizontal lateral component
coordinateContract.surface: mean of target foot surface vertices within 1mm of lowest sampled point; geometric proxy, not force-plate center
coordinateContract.window: existing authored support estimates; no true contact timing validation
